scope: Local rollback result and materialization: target Version/Checkpoint resolution, verified Snapshot CAS materialization, atomic Workspace replacement, Workspace.head and Version Head publication, history preservation, immutable Version graph, retry, failure boundaries, cold reopen, legacy compatibility, and Rollback -> Resume behavior

contract_tests.classification: ignored contract index; not runtime PASS evidence

failure_and_recovery_cases: materialization file-write failure leaves prepared intent and old heads
stale lease fails before physical mutation
stale revision fails before physical mutation
metadata failure before completion commit retries from prepared intent
metadata failure after completion commit reopens as new complete state
cold reopen after parent-directory sync interruption retries deterministically
exact retry returns the same completed RollbackRecord without a second revision
implemented_invariants: Workspace.head equals the target Snapshot root digest after completion
Workspace.version_head_id equals the target Version after completion
historical Versions, parent edges, Snapshots, Operations, Executions, and Checkpoints remain unchanged
Resume creates a new Execution and later Version; rollback does not create a Version
filesystem replacement is staged, verified, and published before guarded metadata completion
physical and metadata failure boundaries are fail-closed and retryable

performance_sanity.measurement: No new performance budget or release acceptance was created in this slice
performance_sanity.notes: Focused rollback runtime completed in 0.48 seconds according to the test harness; this is not ADR-0015 acceptance

limitations: Windows local-native development evidence only; not M1 release evidence
No Git/Remote provider, Provider Registry, CLI, SDK, UI, Branch, Merge, Candidate, Approval, Agent State, or public API behavior
Task-scoped, selective, and cross-workspace rollback remain future contracts
Ignored contract cases are not counted as PASS
Working tree is intentionally uncommitted development state
